title: Escalation Routing Rule R-007: UHID not found in system
content:
ROUTING RULE: R-007 -- UHID not found in system
TRIGGER TYPE: Data State
CONDITION: Query yields zero results across DB
ROUTE TO: Front Office and Registration (Extension 1026)
QUEUE: QUEUE_FRONTOFFICE
PRIORITY: NORMAL
SLA: 4.0 hour(s)
ESCALATION RATIONALE: Demographic reconciliation needed. Possible duplicate Aadhaar or typo. Contact Front Office ext. 1026.
EXAMPLE QUERY 1: Cannot find patient Senthil Kumar with UHID-999999
EXAMPLE QUERY 2: Patient card says UHID-000088 but no records
